title: NDA wins large number of MPTC seats in Godavari region

ai.summary: Former MLA Jakkampudi Raja and YSR Congress Party supporters staged a dharna demanding a recount in Korukonda ZPTC constituency after TDP candidate led in fourth round of MPTC and ZPTC election counting in East Godavari district, leading to arrests and resumed counting.

facts.claim: Tension prevailed at the counting centre at Adikavi Nannaya University after former MLA Jakkampudi Raja and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) supporters staged a dharna demanding a recount of votes polled in the Korukonda ZPTC constituency during the counting of MPTC and ZPTC election results in East Godavari district on Saturday.
facts.quote: Tension prevailed at the counting centre at Adikavi Nannaya University after former MLA Jakkampudi Raja and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) supporters staged a dharna demanding a recount of votes polled in the Korukonda ZPTC constituency during the counting of MPTC and ZPTC election results in East Godavari district on Saturday.

facts.claim: Mr. Raja and his supporters sought a recount after the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) candidate secured a huge lead in the fourth round of counting. The YSRCP had secured a substantial majority in the first three rounds.
facts.quote: Mr. Raja and his supporters sought a recount after the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) candidate secured a huge lead in the fourth round of counting. The YSRCP had secured a substantial majority in the first three rounds.

facts.claim: Later, Mr. Raja and his supporters were arrested, following which the counting resumed.
facts.quote: Later, Mr. Raja and his supporters were arrested, following which the counting resumed.

facts.claim: Meanwhile, counting of ZPTC votes continued at all counting centres across the Godavari region till 9 p.m., with police personnel deployed to prevent any untoward incidents.
facts.quote: Meanwhile, counting of ZPTC votes continued at all counting centres across the Godavari region till 9 p.m., with police personnel deployed to prevent any untoward incidents.

facts.claim: In the MPTC elections, the NDA partners, the TDP and the Jana Sena Party, secured victories in a large number of seats.
facts.quote: In the MPTC elections, the NDA partners, the TDP and the Jana Sena Party, secured victories in a large number of seats.

facts.claim: The winners were advised against taking out victory rallies to prevent any untoward incidents in the Godavari region.
facts.quote: The winners were advised against taking out victory rallies to prevent any untoward incidents in the Godavari region.

ai.background_note: NDA partners, TDP and Jana Sena Party won MPTC and ZPTC elections in East Godavari district, leading to a dharna by YSRCP supporters demanding recount after TDP candidate led in fourth round of counting.
